# Hash-pinned requirements for the workflow auditor.
#
# Why a lock file at all: Scorecard's Pinned-Dependencies check requires that
# every dependency a workflow installs be integrity-pinned, not merely
# version-pinned.  `zizmor==1.5.2` says which version; the hash below says
# WHICH ARTIFACT, which is what closes the "PyPI serves a rebuilt wheel under
# the same version" gap.  `pip --require-hashes` refuses to install anything
# not listed here.
#
# zizmor ships as a self-contained manylinux wheel with no runtime
# dependencies, so this file is intentionally a single entry.
#
# Regenerate when bumping the version:
#   pip download --dest /tmp/z zizmor==<ver>
#   sha256sum /tmp/z/*.whl
zizmor==1.5.2 \
    --hash=sha256:0c5f656106c430748858ae459c41c9eed09a1e01e5f42015d80c8fe34740d173
